facts.anchor: In the dream, Seb tells her that he doesn’t love her anymore
facts.fact: 凯瑟琳连日重复同一个噩梦，梦里塞布对她说自己不再爱她。

facts.anchor: Even here, waking up feels like falling down the stairs: panic, out of control.
facts.fact: 她在日出前醒来，惊醒时像滚下楼梯一样失控，满身是汗。

facts.anchor: Catherine looks out the window at the mess of chimneys.
facts.fact: 凯瑟琳望向窗外成片的烟囱，设想若当初换一种做法自己的生活会是什么样。

facts.anchor: She’s been in Paris for a week, lost six thousand euros before even arriving
facts.fact: 她到巴黎已一周，抵达前就损失了六千欧元，其余开销也花掉不知多少。

facts.anchor: Her daughter isn’t even speaking to her, and Catherine has to tell her the truth
facts.fact: 女儿不跟她说话，而凯瑟琳终究必须把真相告诉女儿。

facts.anchor: If she’s honest with herself, this is the reason why she came.
facts.fact: 她承认自己来巴黎的原因就是赶在太晚之前把真相告诉女儿。

facts.anchor: In the afternoon, she opens up her computer and looks at flights home.
facts.fact: 下午她打开电脑查看回程机票，随后手机响了一声，是伊丽莎白发来的消息。
